project.name: uttf-crm
project.productType: Associazione; cultura hip-hop, educazione e comunità a Rozzano

motion.ticker: 32s, user-pausable, suspended offscreen and for reduced motion

must: Preserve all original photos and both UTTF logos
Foreground community, education, local roots and participation
Retain existing functional forms and staff tools
Do not publish a legal-status label or acronym. User correction supersedes previous assumptions; use Under The Tower Factory or generic associazione in visible copy, metadata and structured data.
avoid: Invented statistics, events, or social proof
Corporate or technical system copy in public flows
Emoji, pictographic ornaments, decorative stars or illustrative icon tiles
Cute sticker styling and excessive rounded cards

decisions.decision: User-directed complete brutalism × claymorphism restyle: bold editorial hierarchy, solid borders and offset shadows, softly sculpted orange icons and buttons, real photos and association-focused navigation.

Hip-hop editorial refinement requested by user: concert-poster typography, photo collage, dark hero, numbered activity rows, scroll reveals and pausable typographic ticker. Remove emoji and decorative icons; retain only functional navigation controls. Respect reduced motion and preserve association content, original palette, photos and logos.

User-selected street/simple redesign preserving the existing page structure, sections, original palette, photographs, logos, association identity and no-emoji constraint. Flat surfaces, Space Grotesk headlines, white hero, straight photo framing, restrained motion. Quietly irreverent copy challenges labels and conformity while preserving mutual respect and inclusive participation.
